title: BPW-2026-0568
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0568
CD ALL
REVISED TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO. 36A & 36B – SIDEWALK REPAIR PROGRAM (SRP)
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue a revision of the task for TOS No. 36A to HDR Engineering, Inc., increasing the budget authority from $4,250,000 to $13,800,000 for 3D design, design support during construction, survey, and construction management services for the SRP; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue a revision of the task for TOS No. 36B to HNTB Corporation, increasing the budget authority from $4,250,000 to $13,800,000 for 3D design, design support during construction, survey, and construction management services for the SRP.
(W.O.: E1909339, C-134275, C-134304)
summary: Citywide Sidewalk Repair Program: raises the budget for two engineering contracts, with HDR Engineering, Inc. and HNTB Corporation, from $4.25 million to $13.8 million each for design, construction support, survey and construction management.

flag.reason: More than triples the design and management budget for the citywide Sidewalk Repair Program's two engineering firms.

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
